answer: Hardware attestation: each key binds once to a crystal, the endorsement key fused into a physical TPM chip. Every epoch the node returns a TPM quote over the seed; a trellis of 3 random established graders verifies it against the vendor cert chain and a registry capping each crystal at 1 identity. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 chips, ~1,000x one honest node. Weakness: virtual TPMs on one server. Fix: graders accept only vendor-signed hardware EK certs and run a delta check, revoking any crystal whose quotes come from 2+ IPs in one epoch.
